brief:
Contributors to The Electronic Intifada have released books documenting their experiences during the genocide in Gaza, the outlet reported. The collection includes memoir, poetry, reportage and personal essays from writers who lived through the conflict.

The works represent firsthand accounts from those with direct experience of events in Gaza, offering perspectives from people on the ground during the ongoing crisis.
dek: Memoir, poetry, reportage and personal essays by contributors to The Electronic Intifada.
title: Gaza writers publish memoirs and essays on genocide
